name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第三门 巴弗洛

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第三门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第三门：70级巴弗洛，约700血。打败获得巴弗洛精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 被电系克制；同等级可先用闪光波克尔同生共死，再用克制精灵先手补杀。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
镇魂歌 (its own skill): the target faints unless the boss is beaten within 3 turns (三回合内未能击败则己方死亡) — a perish-count effect; the boss used it against higher-level pets first.
immune_skill_list: the player's 镇魂歌 has no effect on it (7k7k: BOSS巴菲洛用镇魂歌无效).
风压极闪 is a priority attack that may lower defence.
source_note: 4399 第三门攻略: No.177 飞行系 Lv70 HP700.
